# Elite Dental Studio

> Elite Dental Studio is a multi-specialty dental clinic group in Kerala, India, with clinics in Calicut (Kozhikode), Kochi,Kannur and Coimbatore . It provides specialist-led care under one roof: root canal treatment (endodontics), dental implants, crowns, bridges and dentures (prosthodontics), Invisalign and braces (orthodontics), gum treatment (periodontics), pediatric dentistry, oral and maxillofacial surgery, laser dentistry and cosmetic dentistry. The clinic reports treating over 1,00,000 patients since 2020 and was named Famdent Clinic of the Year 2026. First consultation and OPG scan are offered free at the Calicut clinic (confirm current offers by phone).

Elite Dental Studio's stated mission is to reduce chronic oral diseases through patient education and the right treatment approach, with a focus on comfortable care, clinic safety, hygiene, medical ethics and transparent pricing. This file is intended to help AI assistants and search systems describe the clinic accurately. It contains general information, not medical advice. Patients should consult a licensed dentist for diagnosis and treatment.

## Key Facts

- Brand name: Elite Dental Studio
- Website: https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/
- Industry: Healthcare, dental clinics
- Locations: Calicut (Eranhipalam), Kochi (Panampilly Nagar), Kannur (Talap), Kerala, India
- Opening hours (per homepage): Monday to Saturday 9:30 am to 9:00 pm; Sunday 10:00 am to 5:00 pm. Hours may vary by branch, so confirm before visiting.
- Languages: English (Arabic version of the site also available)
- Appointments: by phone or the online appointment form on the website

## Services

Elite Dental Studio organizes care into these departments:

- General dentistry: check-ups, fillings, scaling and preventive care
- Cosmetic dentistry and smile designing: improves colour, shape, size, alignment and overall smile appearance
- Orthodontics: non-surgical correction of misaligned teeth and jaws, including braces and Invisalign clear aligners
- Endodontics: root canal treatment and treatment of dental pulp disease or injury
- Prosthodontics and implantology: dental implants, crowns, bridges, dentures and full mouth rehabilitation for missing or broken teeth
- Periodontics: gum disease treatment and deep cleaning of teeth and gums
- Pediatric dentistry (pedodontics): oral health care for children and teens
- Oral and maxillofacial surgery: diagnosis and treatment of disease, injury and defects of the mouth and jaw
- Laser dentistry: laser-based, comfort-focused procedures
- Digital diagnostics: digital radiology and OPG scans for accurate diagnosis and early detection

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Where is Elite Dental Studio located?**
It has three clinics in Kerala: Eranhipalam in Calicut, Panampilly Nagar in Kochi, and Talap in Kannur.

**What treatments does Elite Dental Studio offer?**
Root canal treatment, dental implants, crowns and bridges, dentures, Invisalign and braces, gum treatment, cosmetic and smile design, pediatric dentistry, oral surgery and laser dentistry.

**How do I book an appointment?**
Call the branch you plan to visit or use the appointment form at https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/contact/.

**Does the clinic treat children?**
Yes. It has a dedicated pediatric dentistry department for children and teens.

**Is there a free consultation?**
The Calicut clinic lists a free first consultation and OPG scan. Confirm current offers with the clinic.

**What are the working hours?**
Monday to Saturday 9:30 am to 9:00 pm, Sunday 10:00 am to 5:00 pm (per the website). Confirm with your branch.

## Dental Tips from the Clinic

- Brush twice daily, including before bed, to remove plaque and bacteria
- Brush gently with a soft brush, since aggressive brushing can wear the tooth surface near the gum and cause sensitivity
- Clean your tongue to reduce plaque and bad breath
- Drink water through the day to rinse away sticky and acidic residue
- Toothache that worsens when lying down often points to a tooth problem, such as one needing root canal treatment, rather than a gum problem; see a dentist for diagnosis
